entries.title: Step-Growth Polymerization in a Reaction Box
entries.description: A 3D box filled with floating colored monomers that randomly collide and, upon collision, attach to form longer chains that wiggle, bend, and occasionally break, with chain lengths labeled and a meter tracking average polymer size.

entries.title: Linear vs Branched Polymer Chain Dynamics
entries.description: Several long bead-spring chains (linear) and Y-shaped chains (branched) drift and collide in a light-colored box, stretching, coiling, and entangling with different stiffness and colors, while labels show chain type and length.
